text:
chris: Heads-up — need to run a 6h soak for customer X peak profile. Want a hybrid approach: k6 for ingress shaping -> locust workers for backend replay. Can we schedule tonight 02:00 UTC? Target: peak bursts ~500k rps, steady ~30k rps, total duration 6h. Will attach config below.

maria: Sounds heavy but +1. Is this using last week's replay capture or a fresh trace?

chris: Using capture_2026-03-10 (12M reqs). We'll sample by customer-id to preserve 90/10 heavy/light mix. k6 args to shape ingress: 
```
k6 run --vus 5000 --duration 6h --rps 500000 --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 script.js
```
Then locust will consume the payloads and hit /api/v1/ingest endpoints with recorded bodies.

alex: I can take the profiler window on runtime nodes. Plan: 30m flame collection at 03:00-03:30 UTC (perf counters + jemalloc stats). Need run id to tag traces.

jen: Ops note — Dedicated pool A has maintenance 01:30-02:45 UTC. If you start at 02:00 you'll hit degraded capacity and autoscale thrash. Recommend start 03:00 instead. :warning:

chris: OK moving start to 03:00. New timeline: 03:00 start k6 ramp, steady by 03:20, 03:00-03:30 profiler window, ~09:00 end.

sam: I'll reserve extra GPUs and bump autoscale to 1.5x for the window. Also lowering the circuit breaker thresholds (latency tripping) to avoid a hard failure cascade. I'll post the infra diff in a sec.

maria: Who's owning the post-soak regression checks? Need perf-eval notebook + A/B diffs on latency/throughput and error rates.

alex: I'll run perf-eval after the soak and share diffs + flamegraphs. Ping me with the run id and the metrics retention window.

load-bot: scheduled soak run created: https://ci/load-runs/1925001234 — workers: 120 (k6 1 controller + 119 locust), estimated metrics volume ~45GB. Alerts hooked to #eng-oncall.

sam: I'll be oncall for the window. Add me to the run channel and to PagerDuty for this run.

chris: Quick checklist before we close:
- [ ] confirm dataset (maria)
- [ ] reserve capacity & autoscale bump (sam)
- [ ] ops maintenance window avoided (jen)
- [ ] profiler window & owner (alex)
- [ ] perf-eval owner (alex)
- [ ] runbook updated and Slack alerts wired (chris)

I'll post the final launch command and run id ~30m before start. If anyone has objections to 03:00 UTC, speak now. :+1:
